head_commit.message:
Merge reconciled delivery records and complete platform qualification

Preserve both source and documentary histories, all sixty accepted heading
workers, the complete atlas reading, original failure evidence and current
reference-interface captures. Refresh setup, current status and concrete
LibraryModel and visual next steps for future agents.

All sixteen required jobs passed at source 523c197. This documentary merge
retains every existing noncurrent-document entry from that source. The exact
staged repository and strict worker-record checks pass. Whole-interface 1:1,
physical fidelity and device/release exits remain explicitly open.
